name: Transaction notes
author: ptbudget
description: Add or clear the note on a transaction and flag it for review.

tools.name: set_transaction_note
tools.description: Set (or clear with null) the free-text note on a transaction.

note.description: The note text, or null to clear it.

tools.sql: UPDATE transactions SET comment = :note, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = :transactionId

tools.name: flag_transaction
tools.description: Mark a transaction as flagged for review (or unflag it).

flagged.description: true to flag, false to clear the flag.

tools.sql: UPDATE transactions SET is_flagged = CASE WHEN :flagged THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = :transactionId
